features: Tiled balcony with roof slab behind the navy entry door
Aquarium end wall: navy window, plaques and ring planters
House wall: navy exterior door frame, plant print, yellow paint with maroon windows
White steel railing on a concrete ledge with frosted floral screen and greenery
Concrete stair down along the yellow wall, white steel handrail, doormat
Small concrete courtyard with white grille gate and neighbour block wall
Neighbourhood: streets, ~50 houses, trees, poles and a full-moon night sky
Ghost town: parked tricycles, a jeepney, empty food stalls, the bent Malasugue Street sign, barricades

features: Studio room 4.4 x 4.4 m behind a glass sliding door
Black wedge acoustic foam on every wall and the ceiling
Purple LED cove around the ceiling and a HARMONIK neon over the desk
Glass sliding door (E to slide)
Producer couch, plants, wall shelves and a pendant lamp
Guitar wall: Ibanez, Gibson SG, Les Paul and two acoustics on hangers
Marshall and Orange combo amps under the guitars, Fender P-bass on its stand
Drum kit in the back corner, facing the room
Two-tier keyboard station: 61-key synth below, analogue synth above
Gaming / production desk: two curved monitors, RGB tower, keyboard, mouse, MIDI controller, KRK monitors
